news.title: Flexport CEO says German works councils are blocking AI at a European rival

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Ops Tech
roles.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Own the product strategy and execution roadmap for Ops Tech end-to-end—from problem discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration
Define and deliver product features that improve destination dwell management, control demurrage expenses, and elevate on-time delivery metrics
Build high-efficiency internal operator tools and AI-driven automation that simplify complex, multi-step freight execution workflows
Establish quantitative frameworks to track operational metrics, platform health, operator productivity, and cost-to-serve reductions
Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Global Operations, and Commercial leadership to translate physical trade constraints into software solutions

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Commerce
roles.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Define and drive product strategy across the Commerce domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages
Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing
Own the end-to-end roadmap: identifying the highest-leverage problems, sequencing investment, and making clear trade-off recommendations to leadership
Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other product teams to align priorities and ship integrated experiences across surfaces
Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs
